dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Highly prominent, sharp pale white boundaries clearly demarcated against dark grey-brown feather centers along the primaries and secondaries.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: A distinct boundary exists where the uniform brownish-grey texture of the nape meets the high-contrast scalloped pattern of the upper mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Extremely high-contrast white scalloping/fringing present across nearly all visible dorsal feathers except for the head and nape.
